job.title: Sr. Software Engineer - IT Software Engineering
job.pay_full: $133,100 – $210,600 a year typical starting base salary; $159,900 – $252,900 in select locations (including Seattle, Los Angeles, San Francisco Bay Area, New York City metro); eligible for Elastic's stock program

details.about: Elastic's new IT Software Engineering team asks whether it can build a better version of the expensive SaaS tools Elastic pays for, on Elasticsearch, and then builds it. Each system helps run the company and becomes a reference architecture for Elastic's own products. It is a hands-on, 100% individual contributor backend role: not front-end, not prototypes, not SaaS administration and not people management.
duties: Turn open business problems into clear specs, data models and API contracts
Build internal applications that replace paid, specialized tools
Solve shared hard problems: reading from several systems of record efficiently, keeping sensitive data from leaking, and enforcing permissions on the server
Design and evolve shared, versioned building blocks: data connectors, authorization, storage and migrations, search and reporting
Build with AI coding agents inside a disciplined, spec-driven process with automated quality gates
Own systems for their whole life, including releases, production operations and on-call
needs: Senior-level experience designing, shipping and maintaining production backend systems
Sound judgment on what to build and keeping systems simple; design principles such as SOLID
Strong API and data design, and experience integrating with APIs, databases and event streams
Security-first thinking about authorization and sensitive data
Search fundamentals: indexing, text processing, scoring and ranking, keyword vs vector vs hybrid search
Strong TypeScript, Python, Java or similar (the team builds in TypeScript)
Daily, disciplined use of AI coding agents on production work, reviewing their output skeptically
nice: Observability: logs, metrics, traces and alerting
LLM features: RAG, embeddings, LLM gateways and evaluations
A degree in Computer Science or a related field
details.benefits: Typical starting base salary $133,100 – $210,600 a year, or $159,900 – $252,900 in select locations (including Seattle, Los Angeles, the San Francisco Bay Area and the New York City metro). Pay is base salary only, with no variable component; the role is eligible for Elastic's stock program. Benefits include a company-matched 401(k) (dollar for dollar up to 6% of eligible earnings), health coverage in many locations, flexible locations and schedules for many roles, generous vacation, donation matching up to $2,000, up to 40 volunteer hours a year and at least 16 weeks of parental leave.
notes: 100% individual contributor role, not people management
